List sim_tte_ode()'s bundled library models

Source: R/sim_tte_ode.R
sim_tte_ode_models.Rd

The built-in, bundled model names accepted by sim_tte_ode's model argument – the character-string case, not a tte_model-converted user model. Exported so a caller building a scenario grid over model (e.g. a companion package comparing several hazard mechanisms) can enumerate and validate model names programmatically, and look up each model's valid omega targets (see ?sim_tte_ode "Between-subject variability"), instead of hardcoding a copy of names(.ODE_LIBRARY_FILES) (private, @noRd) or reaching in via :::.

Usage

sim_tte_ode_models()

Value

A data frame, one row per model: model (character, passable to sim_tte_ode(model = ...)), bsv_targets (character, comma-separated valid omega target names, or NA when the model takes no omega at all).

Details

"mspline" is included with bsv_targets = NA: it takes no between-subject variability (its hazard is entirely determined by knots/boundary_knots/coefs), which is a different situation from the exponential/Weibull/Gompertz models' empty-but-valid target list (also NA here, for the same reason: omega is rejected outright for those three, exactly as for "mspline", since none of the four has a structural PK/PD parameter for BSV to attach to).

See also

sim_tte_ode, where these names go as model. tte_model, to bring in a model beyond this list. simtte_example_models lists a different set: editable templates for sim_tte_df, not sim_tte_ode() models.

Examples

sim_tte_ode_models()
#>          model                                                bsv_targets
#> 1  exponential                                                       <NA>
#> 2      weibull                                                       <NA>
#> 3     gompertz                                                       <NA>
#> 4    pk_hazard                           CL, V2, Q, V3, KA, KA2, VMAX, KM
#> 5  irm1_hazard CL, V2, Q, V3, KA, KA2, KIN, KOUT, IC50, IMAX, n, VMAX, KM
#> 6  irm2_hazard CL, V2, Q, V3, KA, KA2, KIN, KOUT, IC50, IMAX, n, VMAX, KM
#> 7  irm3_hazard CL, V2, Q, V3, KA, KA2, KIN, KOUT, EC50, EMAX, n, VMAX, KM
#> 8  irm4_hazard CL, V2, KA, KA2, Q, V3, KIN, KOUT, EC50, EMAX, VMAX, KM, n
#> 9  tmdd_hazard      KPT, KTP, V2, KA, KA2, KEL, R0, KDEG, KINT, KON, KOFF
#> 10     mspline                                                       <NA>
